keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Topics to search on Apple Podcasts, e.g. 'saas marketing', 'true crime'.

maxResultsPerKeyword.title: Max podcasts per keyword
maxResultsPerKeyword.description: How many podcasts to return for each keyword at most.

maxResults.title: Max podcasts in total
maxResults.description: Hard cap so you never pay for more than you want.

onlyActive.title: Only active shows
onlyActive.description: Skip shows with no episode in the last N days.

activeDays.title: Active = published within (days)
activeDays.description: A show counts as active if it published an episode within this many days.

minEpisodes.title: Minimum episodes
minEpisodes.description: Skip shows with fewer episodes than this.

requireEmail.title: Only shows with a contact email
requireEmail.description: Only return shows whose feed or description lists a contact email. Turn off to also get shows without one (charged at the lower rate).

language.title: Language filter
language.description: Optional, e.g. 'en'. Matches the feed's language tag.

excludeEmails.title: Opt-out list
excludeEmails.description: Emails to never return (e.g. people who asked not to be contacted).
